verdict.rationale: Firebase offers batch/import-export capabilities (firebase-tools Import/Export users) and Firestore supports chained queries and batched writes implicitly via SDKs, but there's no explicit documentation of an AI-native bulk operations workflow (e.g., batch writes/deletes across many documents driven by an agent) — the MCP server docs mention managing individual auth users, projects, and data rather than bulk operations at scale. missing for 10: explicit bulk write/delete/update APIs exposed via MCP or CLI for AI agents, documentation of batch limits/patterns for AI-driven bulk actions, and independent evidence of successful bulk operations via AI tooling.
